from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
BRIDGE = ROOT / 'tools' / 'mirror_sync' / 'universal_job_bridge.py'
DISPATCHER = ROOT / 'tools' / 'mirror_sync' / 'universal_job_dispatcher.py'


def test_bridge_allows_only_closed_detail_backfill_contract():
    text = BRIDGE.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    assert 'ISCAM_DETAIL_BACKFILL_MODE = "ISCAM_DETAIL_BACKFILL"' in text
    assert 'ISCAM_DETAIL_BACKFILL_ACTIONS_FORBIDDEN' in text
    assert 'ISCAM_DETAIL_BACKFILL_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED' in text
    assert 'ISCAM_DETAIL_BACKFILL_ONLY_SQL_AUDIT_ALLOWED' in text
    assert 'fecha_inicio' in text and 'fecha_fin' in text


def test_dispatcher_executes_only_fixed_backfill_script():
    text = DISPATCHER.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    block = text[text.index('if mode == ISCAM_DETAIL_BACKFILL_MODE:'):text.index('if mode == SOFTRESTAURANT_FULL_HISTORY_MODE:')]
    assert 'backfill_detalle_producto_pendientes.py' in block
    assert '--fecha-inicio' in block and '--fecha-fin' in block
    assert '--unidad' in block
    assert '--commit' in block
    assert 'confirm_detail_backfill' in block
    assert 'sql_readonly_audit' in block
    assert 'shell' not in block.lower()
    assert 'job.get("command")' not in block
    assert 'job.get("path")' not in block


def test_operational_complete_is_terminal_done_state():
    text = DISPATCHER.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    assert '{"INTEGRATED", "READ_ONLY_COMPLETE", "OPERATIONAL_COMPLETE"}' in text
